# ADR-3251: AWS security_groups: Security group description required key for SG 3

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Empty descriptions hide ownership and intent.

## Decision

Security groups MUST set a security group description required key for SG 3 (AWS-security_groups-3).

## Consequences

Descriptions name system and owner.
